body:
#3986 (BUG-2564) review at 20bfe53: CHANGES REQUESTED, 2 x P1. The verdict DID reach the ledger cleanly: PR-3986.jsonl seq 11, verdict request-changes, no sweep_pending barrier. Full CI was green at 20bfe53. Deputy 2 job d6284d, 14:42-14:53 MST. The full report is .aida/review-report-pr-3986.md in the reviewer worktree.

P1-1: retained failed drafts have no production retry path (queue_cmd/work.rs:7142, 7512, 7645).
- If parent recording or verification fails, the one-shot closure returns and the launcher exits. That drops the in-memory LaunchDraft, VerifiedReviewer and grant context, and recovery only prints the draft path.
- Every later launch makes a new UUID directory and issues a new child grant. Nothing consumes the retained draft (record_reviewer_draft is called only in that closure). So a transient ledger failure still loses the review.
- Ask: authorized original-launch recovery, or bounded same-launch retries that keep the validated draft and grant identity and re-check head and authority. Test a real launcher failure followed by recovery.

P1-2: pending-delivery replay never retries deferred findings (review_commands.rs:3242; review_draft.rs:274; gate/review_verdict.rs:3157).
- An approved draft with deferred findings first persists the sweep_pending=true request-changes barrier. After a delivery failure, check_replay returns that barrier, and the replay clones it verbatim, bypassing the builder that restores the intended verdict.
- ledger::record_verdict_at then sees RequestChanges and never emits the findings, so verification stays pending. The launcher conflict check also rejects that same barrier as conflicting, and it compares normalized ledger findings against raw JSON-encoded draft strings.
- NOTE: this is exactly the p18 failure mode (two approvals with deferred BUG-2653 findings stuck as sweep_pending).
- Ask: treat the same-launch pending payload separately from completed or conflicting evidence, restore the intended verdict and normalized findings, retry through the normal writer, and add a deferred-finding delivery-failure/repair/retry regression.

Neither depends on base changes. This is real design rework of the codex lane's c4331da, not ratchet work. Your call on who takes it:
(a) I take it here, in-tree (~/ai/aida-worktrees/integ-3986, head 20bfe53), as a supervised gate-path change, sketching the P1-2 replay fix on the spec first. I'm best placed for P1-2, having seen the p18 incidents.
(b) A codex rework lane.
Round count: this is the 2nd CHANGES REQUESTED on #3986 (1st was 11-14 at 1c14ed3).
-- integration seat
subject: #3986 BUG-2564: CR with 2 P1s (draft retry; pending replay = p18 failure mode); verdict landed cleanly
